messages:
Pri (Support): OrchardFive onboarding blocked—provision returns 403 during key mint. Demo with execs at 16:00 local, customer urgent.
Nia (CSM): Renewal outreach scheduled in 8 days. Escalate to high priority; need comms and contingency ASAP.
Pri (Support): Ticket #71234. Log excerpt:
``` 
2026-03-28T07:12:45Z ERROR provision 403 {"error":"insufficient_token_scope"}
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_XXX" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -d '{"tenant":"orchardfive"}'
```
Jules (CS Ops): Proposed immediate plan: 1) send holding ack with ETA 2h (Pri), 2) Infra to generate single-tenant, least-privilege temp token if needed (Hector), 3) CS to offer to run demo with hosted trial keys if unresolved (Nia), 4) Ops to kick off runbook update and flag onboarding checklist (Jules).
Hector (Infra): Investigating — looks like enforcement of new scope mapping dropped provision:onboard for some token issuers. I can either revert mapping or issue a TTL-limited token scoped to ["provision:onboard"] for orchardfive. Recommend temp token + audit to avoid rollback.
Nia (CSM): Approve temp token under these constraints: TTL <= 5h, single-tenant scope, explicit audit note and post-resolution rotation. Also ask for a short postmortem note we can share.
TempTokenBot: Temporary token request recorded (#temp-req-1207). Audit trail created and locked for review.
Hector (Infra): Generated token, delivered via secure channel, TTL 4h, scope ["provision:onboard"], logged. Tested: provision returns 200 and key created: {"status":"ok","key_id":"k_ov_22"}.
Pri (Support): Delivered to customer; they confirmed keys visible in console and completed seed data import. Customer says "Thanks, but need full postmortem for execs".
Nia (CSM): I'll draft renewal-side note and offer a goodwill credit if onboarding impact > 2 business hours. Also scheduling a 30m bridge with customer + infra for postmortem tomorrow.
Jules (CS Ops): Action items assigned:
- Pri: add ticket + secure convo + receipt to CS handoff doc (owner: Pri)
- Hector: open INF-1199 for permanent scope mapping fix and rollout plan (owner: Hector)
- Nia: notify account exec and prep makegood language (owner: Nia)
- Jules: add provisioning smoke test + pre-kickoff auth check to onboarding checklist (owner: Jules)
Pri (Support): Handoff doc added: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/71234 (logs, ack, temp token audit)
Hector (Infra): INF-1199 filed with rollout timeline. Will include a safe migration and smoke tests.
Nia (CSM): Will run the bridge with OrchardFive and capture enablement feedback; will escalate to Sales for any exec ask.
Jules (CS Ops): Closing loop for this thread; keeping INF-1199 open until runbook and infra fix complete. Great response, team. :clap:
